title: CozmoPhysicalGroundTruthSchema
description: Standardized schema for independent physical ground-truth measurements (laser distance meter or steel tape measure). Rejects system predictions, synthetic estimates, or reconstructed data as ground truth.

property_id.description: Unique identifier of the physical property/building.

room_id.description: Unique identifier of the measured room (e.g. room_01, bedroom_north).

room_name.description: Human readable room designation (e.g. Master Bedroom, Living Room).

measured_by.description: Name and credentials of physical auditor/surveyor conducting laser/tape measurement.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of physical measurement session.

ceiling_height_m.description: True physical floor-to-ceiling height in meters measured via calibrated vertical laser disto.

room_area_m2.description: Independently verified room floor area in square meters (e.g., from surveyor CAD plan).

wall_id.description: Unique wall identifier matching room layout.

measurement_method.description: Audited physical measurement method. Synthetic or prediction inferences are strictly prohibited.

measurement_device.description: Exact tool model (e.g. Leica DISTO D2, Bosch GLM 50 C, Stanley FatMax 8m).

device_accuracy_spec_mm.description: Manufacturer rated device precision in millimeters (e.g., 1.5).

notes.description: Notes regarding obstructions, baseboards, or surface irregularities.

width_m.description: Clear rough or finished opening width in meters.

height_m.description: Opening height in meters if measured.

sill_height_m.description: Window sill height above finished floor in meters.
